title: Chris Bledsoe flies a craft down the Cape Fear River
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Chris Bledsoe flies a craft down the Cape Fear River, about 2007 at Cape Fear River, North Carolina, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he said, "Suddenly the window opened and there was a Capefare River."

plain: Grant Cameron, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, retells something Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man known for his UFO encounters, told him. Bledsoe says that in 2007, suddenly a window opened and he found himself looking down at the Cape Fear River in North Carolina, as if he were flying along it in a craft.
